title: Interaction between Phrasal Structure and Vowel Tenseness in German: An Acoustic and Articulatory Study
why_promising: Primary German production from 10 speakers recorded with electromagnetic articulography. The publication states that WebMAUS pre-alignment was checked and corrected in Praat; every target-word segment was annotated on an interval tier including stop closure/VOT, vowels, fricatives and nasals; prosodic realization was audio-visually inspected by a trained research assistant. The open Zenodo deposit exposes five source data tables (mono.txt, di.txt, mono.art.txt, di.art.txt, meta.speech.dur.txt) plus analysis.R/analysis.html. Acoustic segment annotations therefore clearly satisfy the human-corrected criterion, and the deposit contains extensive acoustic-duration and articulatory/kinematic observations with original subject/word/repetition/condition fields.
open_question: Promote the manually checked acoustic layer after parsing mono.txt and di.txt and building complete source-faithful variable dictionaries. Treat the articulatory tables separately: mview labeling is described as semi-automatic, so verify the extent of human inspection/correction before admitting kinematic landmarks as qualifying manual annotations. Enumerate and checksum all seven public files and retain all supplied columns rather than only variables analyzed in the paper.
